# mapbox auth

Manage Mapbox credentials

4 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox auth login

Log in to Mapbox via OAuth (opens browser)

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Describe what this would change, then exit without changing it. |

```sh
mapbox auth login
```

### mapbox auth logout

Remove stored Mapbox credentials

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Describe what this would change, then exit without changing it. |

```sh

```

### mapbox auth refresh

Force-refresh the stored access token, regardless of expiry

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Describe what this would change, then exit without changing it. |

```sh
mapbox auth refresh
```

### mapbox auth whoami

Show which token the next command will use, and whose it is

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `verify` | `--verify` | no | boolean |  | Check the token with Mapbox, which reading it locally cannot: a revoked token still looks perfectly valid. |

```sh
mapbox auth whoami
```
